results.title: Pipedrive Pricing 2026: What You Actually Pay Per User
results.content:
Pipedrive’s four plans, per seat monthly on annual billing, are Lite ($14), Growth ($39), Premium ($59), and Ultimate ($79). Monthly billing runs $24, $49, $79, and $99.
 There is no permanent free plan. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
 Growth is the entry point for most active sales teams, since Lite lacks two-way email sync, sequences, and automation entirely.
 Premium bundles LeadBooster, Smart Docs, and Projects at no extra add-on charge. [...] Annual billing saves a flat $10 per seat monthly on Lite and Growth, and a flat $20 per seat monthly on Premium and Ultimate.   
  
Because that flat saving is measured against different starting prices, the percentage saved is not uniform across the lineup.   
  
Pipedrive’s own marketing line, “save up to 42%,” reflects the Lite calculation specifically, not an average across all four plans. [...] ### What is the cheapest Pipedrive plan with two-way email sync?

Growth, at $39 per seat monthly on annual billing, is the least expensive plan that includes two-way email sync. Lite does not include this feature at any price.

### Which Pipedrive plan includes LeadBooster?

Premium and Ultimate include LeadBooster at no additional charge. On Lite and Growth, LeadBooster is a separate add-on starting at $32.50 per month, billed per company rather than per seat.

results.title: How Pipedrive prices: pricing page breakdown (2026)
results.content:
The seat is the value metric, and the four plans separate on capability. Lite is 'Focus on selling and let meeting intelligence handle the admin' at US$ 14, Growth 'Automate emails and follow-ups so you can focus on closing' at US$ 39, Premium 'Drive success from lead to close with full-cycle sales tools' at US$ 59, and Ultimate 'Optimize performance with our complete suite of capabilities' at US$ 79, each 'Per seat per month, billed annually'. The ladder follows the sales cycle: Growth adds [...] ### Is Pipedrive implementation free?

Yes. The Pipedrive FAQ states that "implementation is free when you sign up for a pricing plan" that costs "over $400 a year." Annual plans are shown as one payment per seat, from "US$ 168 per seat/year" on Lite to "US$ 948 per seat/year" on Ultimate, so the threshold depends on the plan and number of seats. This makes free implementation available to a wide range of paid teams.

 Billing cycle – You can choose between annual or monthly billing
 Number of seats – You’re charged per seat, whether it’s assigned to a user or not. Learn more about seats and users.
 Add-ons and top-ups – Optional features and usage extensions that follow your plan's billing cycle
 Currency and location – Your location determines the billing currency and available payment methods [...] Note: Only users with account settings access rights can manage Pipedrive billing. Learn more about user management in this article.

Pipedrive offers four pricing plans to fit teams of any size: Lite, Growth, Premium and Ultimate. You can further customize your subscription with optional add-ons and top-ups.
